files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
banaction = iptables-allports
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8
bantime = 2h
[cyrus-imap]
enabled = true
backend = auto
logpath = /dev/null tail
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=errors]
usedns = warn
[sendmail-reject]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
action = %(action_mw)s
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=extra]
ignoreip = ::1 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.1
